The '''Steady-state Power Coupler''' was manufactured by [[Kel-Mar]]. Fitted aboard [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttles]], they were used to charge the [[Zero-G Assault Stormtrooper Armor Mark I]].
